identificationModule.briefTitle: Examination How the Administration Period of Teriparatide Affects Bone Metabolism and Bone Mineral Density Prior to Denosumab Therapy
identificationModule.officialTitle: Examination How the Administration Period of Teriparatide Affects Bone Metabolism and Bone Mineral Density Prior to Denosumab Therapy

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
The aim of this study is to examine the efficacy and adverse events in the following 3 groups in osteoporosis patients:

1. The administration period of teriparatide is less than 6 months and thereafter, denosumab for 24 months.
2. The administration period of teriparatide is from 6 to 12 months and thereafter, denosumab for 24 months.
3. The administration period of teriparatide is more than 12 months and thereafter, denosumab for 24 months.

interventions.name: "Teriparatide", "Forteo® or Teribon"
interventions.description: To examine the effects of terimaratide less than 6 months in osteoporosis

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Change from Baseline Values at 1 year

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:

* Osteoporotic patients who want to take teriparatide and denosumab

Exclusion Criteria:
